This '''purple-skinned being''' worked as an [[Bogga's enforcer gang|enforcer]] for [[Stenness Node]]-based [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] around [[3999 BBY]]. He was part of a mission to Ambria in 3999 BBY, in an attempt to retrieve a lost shipment of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]]. This enforcer was the first to discover the crystals, but he was [[Death/Legends|slain]] when [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] [[Nomi Sunrider]] attacked his group.
